title: Evaluation refusal named_root_sighting_unavailable doesn't tell a session whose recent turns were all runtime-started that it needs a host-delivered turn
outcome: Evaluation refusal named_root_sighting_unavailable doesn't tell a session whose recent turns were all runtime-started that it needs a host-delivered turn
acceptance: When termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses because no named-root sighting exists at the current cut, and the session has a naming pending since its last host-begun turn, the refusal names the pending naming and says it takes effect at the next host-delivered turn (for example, a prompt or a mailbox wake), not only at a background-task completion; a test drives a pending naming followed by an unadmitted runtime-started turn and checks the refusal text names that remedy.
When no naming is pending, the existing refusal is unchanged; a test shows it.
No change to admission: a runtime-started turn still records no turn begin, checkpoint or root sighting.
